intentSummary: Deploy multi-resource application infrastructure to eastus: resource group, App Service Plan, Web App, Storage Account, and Log Analytics workspace
whatFailed: Deployment failed with HTTP 404 SubscriptionNotFound error during API execution, despite valid template and passing all pre-deployment validation checks. Indicates authentication/subscription context issue at execution time.
recommendation: Before executing a validated deployment plan, verify the Azure subscription context is active and accessible: confirm subscription ID matches the intended target, validate service principal or user account has Contributor/Owner role on the subscription, and test Azure CLI/SDK authentication with `az account show` or equivalent. Include subscription context validation as a pre-execution gate, separate from template validation, to catch authentication drift before resource provisioning begins.

intentSummary: Deploy App Service with web app, storage account, and Log Analytics workspace to eastus region with security and cost optimization
recommendation: Storage account names must be lowercase alphanumeric only (no hyphens), max 24 characters. Apply security defaults: enforce HTTPS-only, require TLS 1.2 minimum, and disable public blob access on all storage accounts. Omit Application Insights configuration if instrumentationkey is not used to prevent empty environment variable runtime errors. Use dependency chains in correct order: RG tags first, then storage/logging/compute in parallel, then dependent applications. Tag resource groups at creation time (env=staging, etc.) for cost allocation and governance.

intentSummary: Delete resource group 'my-app-rg' and all contained resources in East US
recommendation: When deleting resource groups with multiple dependencies, explicitly sequence deletions to prevent conflicts: delete child resources with dependencies first (e.g., Web Apps before App Service Plans), then individual resources before the resource group itself. Document soft-delete retention periods (e.g., Log Analytics 14-day retention) to enable recovery windows before permanent deletion. This approach ensures clean deletions and provides recovery options if deletion was unintended.

intentSummary: Deploy multi-tier app infrastructure (App Service Plan, Web App, Storage Account, Log Analytics) to eastus region
whatFailed: Storage account name auto-corrected from "teststorageeastusa-01" to "teststorageeastusa01"; hyphens were stripped during provisioning
recommendation: Storage account names must be lowercase alphanumeric only, maximum 24 characters; hyphens, underscores, and other special characters are not allowed. Validate storage account names against this pattern before template submission to avoid auto-correction and maintain predictable resource naming.

intentSummary: Deploy Azure Container Registry (Standard SKU) with resource group in East US region for Contoso Retail Platform test environment
recommendation: ACR names are automatically sanitized to lowercase alphanumeric (hyphens removed); plan naming with this transformation in mind. Always disable admin user on ACR and enforce managed identity or Azure AD authentication for all image push/pull operations. Tag resource groups with environment and project metadata for cost tracking and lifecycle management.

intentSummary: Deploy multi-resource application infrastructure (resource group, storage account, App Service Plan, Log Analytics, web app) to eastus
recommendation: For subscription-scoped multi-resource deployments: (1) use nested ARM deployments with Microsoft.Resources/deployments, expressionEvaluationOptions.scope=inner, and explicit resourceGroup parameter; (2) create resource group first in outer deployment, then all child resources in inner nested deployment; (3) declare explicit dependsOn on App Service Plan in web app configuration (serverFarmId reference alone does not create ARM ordering); (4) storage account names must be strictly lowercase alphanumeric without hyphens, max 24 chars; (5) use API version 2023-01-01 or later for Web/serverfarms and Web/sites to ensure correct S1 tier/capacity schema; (6) apply consistent security baseline across all resources: HTTPS-only, TLS 1.2 minimum, disable public blob access and FTP.

intentSummary: Delete resource group 'my-app-rg' and all 5 contained resources in correct dependency order
recommendation: Resource group deletions succeed when dependency order is respected (delete dependent resources before parents) and prerequisites are met. Always confirm with users that backups are in place and obtain team approval before executing irreversible deletions. Note that Log Analytics Workspaces enter a 14-day soft-delete retention window—document this window for team visibility and recovery procedures in case rollback becomes necessary.

intentSummary: Deploy app infrastructure (App Service Plan, Web App, Storage Account, Log Analytics Workspace) to eastus for development/testing
recommendation: Storage account naming must follow Azure constraints (lowercase alphanumeric, max 24 characters, no hyphens). Validate and confirm naming corrections with the user before deployment to prevent resource naming drift. F1 Free tier App Service Plans are cost-effective for development/testing but lack SLA, custom domain support, and always-on features—use Standard or Premium tiers for production workloads.

intentSummary: Apply security baseline configurations to Web App and Storage Account
recommendation: Enforce HTTPS-only mode and TLS 1.2 minimum on all Web Apps and Storage Accounts as a default security policy. Disable public blob access on storage accounts unless explicitly required for the workload. Apply these configurations during initial resource provisioning rather than as post-deployment remediation.

intentSummary: Deploy Log Analytics Workspace with retention policy for application logging
recommendation: Document the Log Analytics soft-delete retention window (14-day recovery period) in deployment runbooks. Configure appropriate retention policies at provisioning time based on compliance and cost requirements. The PerGB2018 SKU is suitable for development; consider capacity reservation SKUs for production workloads with predictable log volumes.

intentSummary: Execute multi-resource deployment with proper dependency sequencing
recommendation: For nested ARM deployments with subscription-scoped resource group creation, set expressionEvaluationOptions.scope=inner to enable proper resource evaluation. Sequence deployment as: (1) resource group creation, (2) parallel creation of independent resources (Log Analytics, Storage, App Service Plan), (3) dependent resources (Web App after App Service Plan). This approach reduces deployment time and prevents blocking dependencies.
